column2: Use CLI commands to show the interface ipv6 prefixes
column4:
UI6:

To modify one prefix need send all the interfaces' prefixes

To add one prefix also need send PUT with full prefixes

UI7:

Move prefixes out of interface mode
column5:
Step4 Each instruction correspond result:

show advertising-prefixes (show all interfaces' prefixes):
advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 1::
    valid-lifetime 12345
    preferred lifetime 12345
    on-link
    autonomous
    exit

advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 2::
    valid-lifetime 12345
    preferred lifetime 12345
    on-link
    autonomous
    exit

show advertising-prefixes interface X3 (show interface X3's prefixes):
advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 1::
    valid-lifetime 12345
    preferred lifetime 12345
    on-link
    autonomous
    exit

advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 2::
    valid-lifetime 12345
    preferred lifetime 12345
    on-link
    autonomous
    exit

show advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 1:: (show specified prefix)
advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 1::
    valid-lifetime 12345
    preferred lifetime 12345
    on-link
    autonomous
    exit

show advertising-prefixes match valid (show matched prefix)
advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 1::
    valid-lifetime 12345
    exit

advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 2::
    valid-lifetime 12345
    exit

show advertising-prefixes except valid (show other prefix)
advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 1::
    preferred lifetime 12345
    on-link
    autonomous
    exit

advertising-prefix interface X3 prefix 2::
    preferred lifetime 12345
    on-link
    autonomous
    exit
column6:
1. Configure X3 for IPv4

2. Configure X3 as static for IPv6
